description_en: Create a user group. You can specify a parent user group
description_zh: 新建用户组，可以指定父用户组
kebab_example: aliyun quickbi-public create-user-group --user-group-name '杭州财报' --parent-user-group-id 3d2c23d4-2b41-4af8-a1f5-f6390f320000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateUserGroup

parameters.help_en:
The unique ID of the user group.

If you specify the UserGroupId parameter, the system automatically generates the UserGroupId parameter. If you specify the UserGroupId parameter, the user ID is used as the user group ID. You must ensure that the user ID is unique within the organization.
Format verification: Maximum length 64, cannot be -1,
parameters.help_zh:
用户组唯一ID。

无需传入，系统会自动生成；当用户主动传入UserGroupId时，以用户传入的ID作为用户组ID，用户需要自行保证该ID在组织内唯一。
格式校验：最大长度64，不能为-1，
parameters.name: user_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the RAM user group.

Format verification: Maximum length 255
Special format verification: Chinese and English digits_ \ / | () ] [
parameters.help_zh:
用户组名称。

格式校验：最大长度255
特殊格式校验：中英文数字 _ \ / | () ] [
parameters.name: user_group_name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the user group.

Format verification: Maximum length 255
Special format verification: Chinese and English digits_ \ / | () ] [
parameters.help_zh:
用户组描述。

格式校验：最大长度255
特殊格式校验：中英文数字 _ \ / | () ] [
parameters.name: user_group_description

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the parent user group. You can add new user groups to this group:

If you enter the ID of a parent user group, the new user group is added to the user group with the ID.
If you enter -1, the new user group is added to the root directory
parameters.help_zh:
父用户组ID。可以将新建的用户组添加到该分组下：
当输入父用户组ID时，新建的用户组会添加到该ID的用户组下。
当输入-1时，新建的用户组会添加到根目录下
parameters.name: parent_user_group_id

Result.description_en: The ID of the added user group is returned. An empty string '' is returned if the add fails
Result.description_zh: 返回用户组添加成功后的ID。如果添加失败，返回空字符串“”

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
是否请求成功。取值范围：

true：请求成功
